name: Audio Boost
whoFor: Women (cis and trans) and gender-diverse people in Kirklees who are not in work or claiming Universal Credit and are living with a health condition, who want skills and confidence for work in the audio sector.
locations: Various locations in Huddersfield (to be confirmed), with online support
3M Buckley Innovation Centre, Firth Street, Huddersfield, HD1 3BD
eligibility: Women (cis and trans) and gender-diverse people
Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
exclusions: People in paid employment or self-employment
People who don't live in Kirklees
gate: Women (cis and trans) and gender-diverse people
Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
referralRoutes: Email info@yorkshiresoundwomen.com to request a link to the application and any assistance if needed

selfReferral.note: Fill in the form linked to in the information page.

projects.name: Audio Boost
projects.overview: Hands-on beginner workshops, talks and one-to-one support covering music technology roles such as producing tracks, DJing, engineering live events and making podcasts and radio shows, plus practical advice on finding work, in a friendly, supportive environment.
projects.duration: Six fortnightly sessions, running from 8 January until 19 March 2027

sessions.name: Audio Boost
sessions.note: Six fortnightly sessions, starting Friday 8 January 2027. Places must be booked before the course starts (no drop-ins)

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - applications via the Yorkshire Sound Women Network website and social media; sessions start week commencing 4 January 2027

coachNotes: Session 6 (Friday 19 March) will take place at Northern Quarter,  28-30 Wood Street, Huddersfield, HD1 1DU. Applicants should say on the sign-up form if they will have any difficulty accessing the venue (some steps) and if so we will work to arrange an alternative session for them.
